subject: Important Update: Qwen Chat is Now Qwen Studio
body_text:
Qwen Chat is Now Qwen Studio
Dear Qwen User,
Thank you for being part of our platform.
After careful consideration and aligned with our platform's mission, we're excited to
                        announce that Qwen Chat is now officially renamed to Qwen Studio, effective today. We
                        have updated the
Terms of Service
and
Privacy Policy
accordingly.
What This Means for You
✅
Seamless Transition:
All your existing data, settings, and capabilities remain unchanged.
✅
Enhanced Platform:
Qwen Studio continues to empower both everyday users and developers with unified
                                access to Qwen's series of open-source and proprietary models.
✅
Core Features:
Natural & contextual conversations
Advanced multimodal understanding (text, image, audio, video)
Tool calling & function integration
Real-time audio/video conversations
AI-powered image generation & editing
Video generation capabilities
What's Next
We're actively evolving Qwen Studio's interface and experience to make it even easier for
                        you to discover, test, and leverage the full potential of Qwen models—whether you're
                        building applications or exploring AI creatively.
We'd Love Your Input
Your feedback shapes our roadmap. If you have suggestions, feature requests, or questions
                        about the Qwen Studio upgrade, please don't hesitate to reach out:
DPO_qwenlm-intl@service.alibaba.com
Thank you for your continued trust and support. We're thrilled to embark on this next
                        chapter with you.
Best regards, The Qwen Team
